title: Keep HTTP handler decorators when cloning a WebFlux handler builder
summary: A clone retained its configured HTTP decorator. Independently extending the two builders produced ordered markers A,B and A,C, including A,C on another clone of the original.

change.description: The builder copy constructor now carries the composed HttpHandler decorator function into clone(). Existing builds of the original builder still use its configured decorator.

notes: Each fresh request completed at a terminal WebHandler that recorded the full path and every header value.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-web-5.3.0-RC1-q20. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
